# Closed callback marker constructors

A package final class delegates its raw compiler access constructor to an exact
private constructor with a closed contravariant callback. Frozen ordinary,
reflective and method-handle callers check superclass publication, scalar bits,
callback identity, partial fields, failure identity and a late callback result
cast. The original variant uses a parameterized parent with a package type
argument. All programs are independently authored and contain no application data.

The `--plain-parent` variant copies the sources into a fresh directory and makes
Parent nongeneric. Core retains the same callback and private delegation. All 64
cases run twice with owned and imported declarations; complete metadata
comparison requires a plain superclass and no class Signature. The witnessed
marker synthetic flag encoding remains the only deliberate metadata change.
